name: Analyze and interpret specific songs and musical artists
description: Users asked for detailed analysis, interpretation, and evaluation of specific songs, musicians, and music videos, often seeking validation of their own observations or deep dives into lyrical meaning and stylistic elements. They also requested factual verification, such as comparing artists, identifying genres, or assessing the feasibility of collaborations.
